The routings and BOMs checked are those the run was read from (productionMethodRefs: a phantom's routing whether or not a line names its operation). Then the operation children (WetTask, WeApproved, the run's owner, each with its routing operation, sequence and work center, audit-logged) from the routings as of the method date, the lines frozen (frozenDate) on their operations, the WorkEffortProduct rows rewritten from the lines, the frozen standard (the approved ProductStandardCost in effect now for the organization and facility, Products P9) and the release time stamped, the revision counted up, and the run WeApproved. The quality gates are kept with their templates as of the release (impl-manufacturing P8, ProductionQualityGate): an operation's in-process gate, an output line's final gate; an operation naming a template that is not published refuses the release (TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_PLAN; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not a draft (RUN_NOT_DRAFT), a changed revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a run with no lines (LINES_REQUIRED) and a product that cannot be produced (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE).

A retry with the same operation key answers the first. With the run's completeOnFinalReceipt policy flag (off by default), a running run that reconciles after the receipt is completed in the same transaction (completed). service.description: The production runs of the user's organizations (design-manufacturing WorkOrders), paged, each with its product, planned and good quantity, what is left, due date, facility, status and readiness, as display text. Open runs by default (statusId all, or a comma list, for others); a plant takes the lines under it. The saved finds' filters: ready (released, no short line), late (open and past due), blocked (on hold or a line released short), mine (the user assigned on the run or an operation), productId (By product); also assigneePartyId, demandOrderId (a sales order's supplying runs), text (id or name, ignoring case) and the due range. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED).

A run's lifecycle as WorkOrderDetail shows it: the run (status, revision, product, planned, good and left, dates, method and release time, demand links, staged approval), each action open from its status with what it would do (impact) or why it is refused (reasonCode, message: the user's permission, a reason to give, the release gate's findings, facts), its shortages while a draft, its stock and time facts, and its status history with the reasons. Reads only. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The one path to a production run's status (design-manufacturing WorkOrderDetail Lifecycle, the WorkOrders board and bulk action; R-MFG-11): an action, or the move to toStatusId a board makes, on the run at its expected revision, with an operation key (a retry answers the first result). release (PRODUCTION_PLAN) runs the release gate and then release#ProductionOrder: the product usable (PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), the method valid as of the method date (METHOD_INVALID), no later release of its methods (METHOD_CHANGED, with reexplode offered: reexplode rewrites the draft as of now, REEXPLODED, to review and release again), and the shortage policy in effect at the release time: all components covered, or a staged release a supervisor approved at this revision (SHORTAGE otherwise), or a staged release by the policy (PsrStaged); a staged release leaves its short lines blocked for issue until the stock covers them, and the release notifies the organization's supervisors (ProductionRelease). unrelease (PRODUCTION_PLAN) takes a released run that has no stock or time fact (RUN_HAS_FACTS) back to a draft, its operations cancelled and its lines unfrozen. start, hold (a reason), resume (as released before a start, as running after), cancel (a reason; a draft, released or held run with no fact) and complete need PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE; complete (impl-manufacturing P7) needs each output line reconciled, target = good + held + remaining + approved loss with nothing remaining (QUANTITIES_UNRECONCILED; finishRemainder records what is left as an approved loss with the reason) and nothing held awaiting disposition (OUTPUT_HELD), no loss waiting for approval (LOSS_PENDING), no operation running or held (OPERATION_OPEN; those not reported complete with it) and each material line issued (MATERIAL_UNISSUED, unless acceptMaterialVariance), then every operation completed on the shop floor (OPERATION_UNREPORTED, unless closeUnreportedOperations closes them with it; impl-manufacturing P10); close is the cost close's (CLOSE_BY_COST_CLOSE). The quality gates (impl-manufacturing P8): start and resume refuse a run with a failed gate (QUALITY_BLOCKED, naming the inspection); complete refuses a final inspection pending or failed (INSPECTION_PENDING, INSPECTION_FAILED) and an in-process gate not passed (QUALITY_GATE_OPEN), before the quantities; a release refuses an operation template that is not published (TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE); unrelease and cancel count the run's inspections as facts. requestStaged (PRODUCTION_PLAN) asks the supervisors to approve a staged release of a short draft (ProductionStagedRelease); approveStaged (PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE) approves it at the next revision. Refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), no revision (REVISION_REQUIRED) or a changed one (REVISION_CHANGED), an action from another status (STATUS_INVALID, RUN_NOT_DRAFT), a generic transition such as In Planning to Complete (TRANSITION_INVALID), a missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED) or an inactive reason code (REASON_INVALID), and a user without the action's permission (PERMISSION_DENIED).

service.description: Record a loss inside an open run (design-manufacturing ScrapLoss RecordLoss, R-MFG-20; §12 M2 and M6), by its path: PltComponentScrap, issued material of a material line scrapped in WIP, no more than its net issue less what was scrapped, with a scrap cost event (record#ProductionCostEvent, PcetMaterialScrap at its asset's or the line's issued cost, awaiting the cost close) and no stock movement; PltOutputScrap of an output asset of this run, received or held, issued back to the run (issue#AssetToWorkEffort with the run's workEffortId and the loss, whose hook posts it into WIP so the loss reaches production variance at the cost close, never a Warehouse adjustment; needs STOCK_ISSUE), or of output scrapped before it was stock (no asset); PltProcessLoss, a quantity only; and PltRework, units sent to rework (reworkWorkEffortId). A loss in output units writes its quantity event. The reason is an active production reason of the run's owner in the loss's category, or a reason's text; above the reason's approval threshold (a percent of the line's quantity) the loss waits for a supervisor (PlsPending, the ProductionLossApproval notice) with no effect until approve#ProductionException, unless a supervisor records it. Free stock outside a run is scrapped in Warehouse (scrap#Asset). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not open (RUN_NOT_OPEN), an unknown type (LOSS_TYPE_INVALID), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), a line of another run or role (LINE_INVALID), more than was issued (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ISSUED), an asset not of the line or run (ASSET_INVALID), stock outside the user's facilities or short (posting.stock's refusals, QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE), another owner's (OWNER_MISMATCH), an inactive or other-category reason (REASON_INVALID), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and a closed fiscal period today (PERIOD_CLOSED).

Reads only. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or STOCK_ISSUE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A run's material lines as Components and MaterialIssueReceipt show them (design-manufacturing Components): each line's operation, product, required quantity in the stock unit with the scrap allowance of the run's policy, issued, returned and remaining, the stock free for it at the facilities the run nets against (its facility and, for a line, the plant above it), shared in line order, what is short, the owner's stock held there by status apart (quarantine, on hold, defective; never from available to promise, R-MFG-24), a staged release's short quantity, and whether a planner added it by hand; with withStock, the available stock each line may be issued from, oldest lot expiry first. Also the run's consumption policy (manual or backflush, the issue point), a draft's routing operations, and whether the user may add lines (PRODUCTION_PLAN, a draft) or issue (STOCK_ISSUE, a released run). The line is marked manual, so a re-explosion of the method keeps it; the planning rows (WeptConsume) are rewritten and the revision counts up, so a staged approval is asked again. A line from the method is changed only through the method. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Refuses a subcontract outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a closed subcontract (SUBCONTRACT_CLOSED), an ordered one's supplier, quantity, unit or date (SUBCONTRACT_ORDERED), and request#SubcontractService's checks of the values.

service.description: The components of a subcontracted operation (design-manufacturing SubcontractDetail Materials): each material line of the operation (else of the run) with its owner (the run's organization, also at the vendor), quantity and unit, what was sent to the vendor-custody facility and returned from it, what is held there now, what was consumed there (issued to the run from it), issued in all and left; and the subcontract dispatches and returns of the operation. No cost is read. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_PLAN, PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT or STOCK_ISSUE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The outside processing of an operation (design-manufacturing SubcontractDetail Agreement and Acceptance): its run and operation, its subcontract (the agreement; the price basis only for a price reader), the service purchase lines (OrderItemWorkEffort) with their order status, ordered, accepted (ServiceAcceptance, with the output receipt and inspection as evidence), billed and remaining quantities and match exceptions, the unit price and amount only for a buyer or price reader (PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, SUPPLIER_PRICE_VIEW, SUPPLIER_PRICE_EDIT or ACCOUNTING_VIEW), the output line and its receipts on the operation (held for inspection or not), the dispatch and return counts, the state, the outside-processing cost events (their amounts only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW) and what the user may do. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_PLAN, PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT or STOCK_ISSUE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The outside-processing worklist (design-manufacturing SubcontractOperations): each operation of the user's organizations' open runs (closed ones with includeClosed) that has a subcontract or a service purchase line, with its run, plant, supplier, service product, order and its status, quantity, dispatches, output received, service accepted, required date, state and whether it has an exception (a match exception, no supplier); the unit price only for a buyer or price reader. Filtered by supplier, plant (with the facilities under it), run, order status, state and exceptions only; soonest due first, a page at a time. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_PLAN or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED).

An order as Manufacturing reads it (design-crosscut §3.6 Manufacturing row): a subcontract purchase order or a sales order linked to a run the user sees: its header and items, each with its production links (a service line's run and operation through OrderItemWorkEffort, with what was accepted; a sales line's supplying runs through the run's demand order), prices only for a price reader (a purchase: PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, SUPPLIER_PRICE_VIEW, SUPPLIER_PRICE_EDIT or ACCOUNTING_VIEW; a sale: PRICE_VIEW, PRICE_EDIT or ACCOUNTING_VIEW). Read only: nothing is placed or approved here. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_PLAN or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an order linked to none of the user's runs (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A subcontract dispatch or return as Manufacturing reads it (design-crosscut §3.8 Manufacturing row, read only): its lines with what was sent and reached the other end, the run and operation, the service order item, the origin and destination, the vendor-custody facility and its custodian, and the owner of the stock (the run's organization throughout, R-SA-08). Dispatch and return are Warehouse's (SubcontractShipmentDetail). Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_PLAN, PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT or STOCK_ISSUE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a shipment that is not a subcontract dispatch of a run the user sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The shop floor queue (design-manufacturing ShopFloor Station and Queue): the operations of the released, running and held work orders of the user's organizations at a plant or work center (with the lines under it), or of one work order, each with its run, product, work center, due date, state (running, ready, paused, blocked or done) and readiness reason (a predecessor, a quality gate, a staged short line, a work order not started), and whether the user's person timer is on it; mine: only work orders or operations the user is assigned to; readyOnly: only ready and running ones; done ones only with includeDone. At most 100 work orders are read (truncated). The groups are the board's columns; timer is the user's running timer. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_OPERATE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a facility outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_OPERATE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

An operation's instructions as of its work order's release (design-manufacturing Instructions Steps): the published WectInstruction WorkEffortContent rows of its routing operation and operation template in effect at the release time, in order, each with its text (a Markdown or text file), file name, checksum and whether the user acknowledged it; a revision warning when a newer one was published since; the evidence the operation requires (its routing operation's or template's methodRequiredEvidence) and whether it is recorded; and every acknowledgment and evidence row. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_OPERATE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Record an operator's instruction step (design-manufacturing Instructions Evidence): IstAcknowledge, the user's acknowledgment of an instruction (workEffortContentId) of the operation as of its release, once per person (a second answers ALREADY_ACKNOWLEDGED); IstEvidence, the evidence the operation requires as a value with its unit, a file reference or a note. An InstructionAcknowledgment of its own: who, when and which instruction row. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a work order not released or running (RUN_NOT_RELEASED), an operation complete or cancelled (OPERATION_CLOSED), a user without a person (PARTY_REQUIRED), an instruction not the operation's (INSTRUCTION_INVALID), evidence without a value or file (VALUE_REQUIRED) or of an operation that requires none (EVIDENCE_NOT_REQUIRED), and an unknown step (STEP_INVALID).

A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a user without a person (PARTY_REQUIRED), the first failed check: RUN_NOT_RUNNING, RUN_ON_HOLD, OPERATION_CLOSED, PREDECESSOR_NOT_STARTED, QUALITY_BLOCKED, MATERIAL_SHORT, EQUIPMENT_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_ASSIGNED, SKILL_MISSING or ACKNOWLEDGMENT_REQUIRED (the last two unless a supervisor overrode them), and a timer running elsewhere without confirmSwitch (TIMER_SWITCH_REQUIRED, naming it).

A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one not running (OPERATION_NOT_RUNNING), an inactive reason (REASON_INVALID) and no reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

Complete an operation (design-manufacturing OperationExecution CompleteStep), in one transaction: its quantities through record#ProductionQuantity under this operation's key, so the operation that receives the output receives its good and pending output with the loss, scrap and rework coupled to it (any other operation records only its loss), then the user's person timer on it stopped (unless stopTimer is false), the pieces on its entry (TimeEntry.pieceCount = good) under the piece-rate policy, and the operation Complete with its good and lost quantity. A failed posting leaves nothing completed. Beyond the target and tolerance only an overproduction request is recorded and the operation stays open (APPROVAL_REQUESTED). A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_OPERATE, and STOCK_ISSUE when it receives output (PERMISSION_DENIED, STOCK_ISSUE_REQUIRED); refuses an operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one complete or cancelled (OPERATION_CLOSED) or not started (OPERATION_NOT_STARTED), a work order not running (RUN_NOT_RUNNING), a predecessor not complete (PREDECESSOR_OPEN, naming it), required evidence not recorded (EVIDENCE_REQUIRED), machine runtime still running (MACHINE_RUNNING), a negative quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), and record#ProductionQuantity's refusals.

service.description: Record a machine's runtime on an operation apart from a person's time (design-manufacturing OperationExecution MachineRuntime, R-SA-18): start (an open interval), stop (its end, now when empty) or record (a closed interval from fromDate to thruDate), on the operation's work center and, when named, its equipment. A closed interval is valued at the work center's approved machine WorkCenterRate in effect at its start, and its cost event (PcetMachine, awaiting the cost close) is written through record#ProductionCostEvent; with no rate in effect it is recorded unvalued and listed for review (§4). service.description: The labor cost events of production time (design-manufacturing ProductionTime; impl-manufacturing F34, F35), called by mantle.work.TimesheetServices approve# and reopen#Timesheet (timesheetId) and mantle.work.TimeServices store# and delete#TimeEntry (timeEntryIdList, deleting) beside their post#WorkEffortCost: for each entry on a production run (the run or one of its operations) whose owner's production policy has laborCostSync, the delta between its hours while its timesheet is approved and what its labor events recorded, through record#ProductionCostEvent (PcetLabor, awaiting the cost close): an approval values the entry at the costing RateAmount (RaprProductionCost) by position class and work type, else unvalued; a reopen or a deletion writes the reversal; an hours change of an approved entry a delta at its rate; a change of its work type, position class, date or work effort that no longer fits the recording reverses it and records it again. Other entries and runs with the flag off record nothing, so Projects' behavior is unchanged; an entry that fails is logged and named (failedTimeEntryIds) and the others go on. Internal: no permission of its own.

A work order's person time (design-manufacturing ProductionTime): the time entries on it and its operations (or one operation), newest first and at most 500, each with the person, operation, work type, from, thru, hours, pieces, its timesheet's status and whether its labor cost is recorded (the amount only with ACCOUNTING_VIEW); each week of that time with its status and whether the user may approve, reopen or submit it (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.get#TimesheetAccess); the total hours and the user's timer. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_OPERATE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a work order or operation outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A run's controlled changes (design-manufacturing Components Substitute, BillOfMaterialsCompare's amendment): its substitution and amendment requests, newest first, each with its summary, reviews and whether the user may decide it; the material lines with the substitutes their BOM line's rule allows (BsrEquivalent: the component's PatEquivalent rows) and what they have left; whether the user may ask a substitute or an amendment (strict release refuses both on a released run); and the run it was split, backordered or cloned from. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Substitute an allowed alternative for a material line's remaining quantity (design-manufacturing Components Substitute, R-MFG-36, R-SA-05): request (PRODUCTION_PLAN or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE) names the line, the substitute, the quantity of the original it replaces (its remaining by default) and the factor (substitute stock units per original unit, 1 by default) with a reason; approve or refuse (PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE) decides a request on the run. The candidate comes from the BOM line's rule only: BsrEquivalent offers the component's active PatEquivalent rows, and any other product is refused. Applying it adds a material line of the substitute beside the original (its operation and BOM line, substituteOfLineId), lowers the original by what moved, rewrites the WeptConsume rows so planning does not count the demand twice, and counts the revision up; on a released run this is an amendment of its lines, audit-logged. A supervisor's own request, or one under a policy with substituteApproval N, applies at once; otherwise the organization's supervisors are told (ProductionSubstitution) and the decision revalidates the request. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a closed one (RUN_CLOSED), a released one under strictRelease (STRICT_RELEASE), a changed revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED, CHANGE_STALE), a line of another run or a substitute line (LINE_INVALID), a product the rule does not allow (SUBSTITUTE_NOT_ALLOWED), a quantity beyond what the line has left (QUANTITY_INVALID, QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_REMAINING), another stock unit with no factor (UNIT_INCOMPATIBLE), a second request of a line (CHANGE_PENDING), a missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED, REASON_INVALID) and a decided or unknown change (CHANGE_DECIDED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: What an amendment of a released run to its method as of methodDate (now by default) would remap (design §12.1, the amendment policy of impl-manufacturing §4): each method material line kept (issued, scrapped or on an executed operation: its facts and links stay), changed (quantity, product, operation or BOM line, less what substitutes took, never below what was issued), added or removed, and each operation kept (started or with facts), changed, added or cancelled; the findings and a previewKey. allowed false with AMEND_NOT_RELEASED (a draft or closed run), STRICT_RELEASE (the policy refuses amendments), METHOD_INVALID or NO_CHANGE. Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW, PRODUCTION_PLAN or METHOD_APPROVE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

An audit-logged amendment of a released run's remaining lines and operations to its method as of methodDate (design §12.1, R-MFG-36; the amendment policy of impl-manufacturing §4): request (PRODUCTION_PLAN or METHOD_EDIT) at the run's revision, with a reason and the preview's key, records the remap (preview#ProductionAmendment) and a change notice when Products' ChangeNotices is on; approve (METHOD_APPROVE or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE) gives the user's reviews, a method approver's and a production supervisor's, each revalidating the remap, and the amendment applies when both are given (one user holding both gives both): only unexecuted lines and operations change, the original facts keep their lines and operations, the WeptConsume/WeptProduce rows are rewritten, and the run's method date, routing and method refs move at the next revision. The method approvers are told first (ProductionAmendment), then the supervisors. refuse (either permission) ends it with a reason. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a draft or closed run (AMEND_NOT_RELEASED), one released under strictRelease (STRICT_RELEASE: a method change needs a linked new run), a changed revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED, CHANGE_STALE) or remap (PREVIEW_CHANGED), a method that changes nothing (NO_CHANGE) or is not valid (METHOD_INVALID), a second request (CHANGE_PENDING), a missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED, REASON_INVALID), a review the user does not give (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a decided or unknown change (CHANGE_DECIDED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A backorder with complete (PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE) completes the running source in the same transaction (P7's reconciliation, acceptMaterialVariance as there). Receipts, issues, time and WIP stay on the source. A retry with the same operation key answers the same runs. service.description: The reviewed plan to cancel a released, running or held run that has postings or has started (design-manufacturing WorkOrderDetail: never a deletion; its facts are those the lifecycle's cancel refuses: issues, receipts, time, P7's quantity events and losses, P8's inspections): mode reversal when nothing was received, lost or timed (each issue's unreturned quantity returned into its asset, then the run cancelled), else residual (the unused issues returned when returnUnused, what is left finished as an approved loss, the material variance accepted and the run completed for the cost close), with its steps, the returns and a previewKey; allowed false with NO_FACTS (cancel from the lifecycle), STATUS_INVALID, or the completion's refusal (OUTPUT_HELD, LOSS_PENDING, OPERATION_OPEN). Requires PRODUCTION_VIEW or PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE; refuses a run outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Cancel a run that has postings by its reviewed plan (preview#ProductionCancellation), in one transaction: a reversal returns each issue (return#UnusedMaterial, STOCK_ISSUE, each with its own cost event) and cancels the run and its operations; a residual close returns the unused issues when asked, finishes what is left as an approved loss, accepts the material variance and completes the run, which Accounting's cost close settles. Nothing is deleted. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires PRODUCTION_SUPERVISE; refuses what the preview refuses, a changed revision (REVISION_REQUIRED, REVISION_CHANGED), no preview or a changed one (PREVIEW_REQUIRED, PREVIEW_CHANGED), a missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED, REASON_INVALID) and returns without STOCK_ISSUE (PERMISSION_DENIED).
